Name: Portraits Mod by Pingchu
Author: Wendyxxxx
Description:
解压后，你会看到每个NPC都有一个自己的文件夹，里面是此NPC的一组xnb文件。
[b]使用方式：复制全部xnb文件到[u]Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits[/u]文件夹替换掉原版xnb文件即可。[/b]
[i]*艾利欧特的文件夹中包含两个子文件夹，分别是original和glasses version（眼镜版），各包含一组对应的xnb肖像文件。只需复制你想使用的一组xnb文件以替换掉原版xnb文件即可。[/i]
目前已更新艾利欧特，谢恩，莉亚，海莉和艾米丽，我将持续更新其他可婚角色~

After extracting the files, you will see that each NPC has their own folder containing a set of [b].xnb[/b] files.
[b]How to Use: Copy all the .xnb files into the [u]Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits[/u] folder and replace the original .xnb files.[/b]
[i]*Elliott’s folder contains two subfolders: [b]original[/b] and [b]glasses version[/b], each including a set of corresponding [b].xnb[/b] portrait files. Use the set you prefer to replace the original [b].xnb[/b] files.[/i]
Currently,[b] Haley[/b], [b]Shane[/b], [b]Leah[/b], [b]Elliott[/b] and [b]Emily[/b] are available. I will continue updating the other marriage candidates~
